name: someone else
arrivals: Somebody comes in behind you and does not go out again.
You are not alone in here, and you have not been for a moment or two.
There is somebody here now. They came in the way people come into a room they know.
departures: Whoever it was is not here now. You did not see them leave.
The room is yours again, and it is worse.
They have gone through to the next one, ahead of you.
looks: Somebody you know. You will have the name in a moment.
They are facing slightly away and are about to turn round.
They are doing something ordinary with enormous care and will not be interrupted.
It is you, from behind, and neither of you is going to mention it.
